title: Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements Stockroom Control Card for Pieces Held, Substitution Tolerance and Price Protection
content:
# Stockroom control card: held merchandise

Inventory control keeps, for each plan of Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements, how many pieces one agreement may hold, whether a held piece may be swapped for another and how far the swapped piece's price may differ, and how long after opening a fall in the ticket price is passed on to the customer.

| Plan | Most pieces one agreement may hold | Substitution admitted | Tolerance on the substituted piece's price | Price protection window (calendar days after opening) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30-Day Hold Agreement | 1 | yes | 10 percent | 30 |
| 90-Day Layaway | 2 | yes | 15 percent | 30 |
| 6-Month Layaway | 3 | yes | 20 percent | 45 |
| 12-Month Bridal Layaway | 4 | yes | 25 percent | 60 |
| Special Order Layaway | 1 | no | 0 percent | 0 |
| Gift Registry Layaway | 6 | yes | 20 percent | 45 |

## Card notes

- The tolerance is how far the substituted piece's price may differ from the original, as a percentage. The Special Order Layaway admits no substitution and carries a tolerance of 0 percent.
- The price protection window is the number of calendar days after opening within which a fall in the ticket price is passed on to the customer. The Special Order Layaway carries a window of 0 days.
- A single-piece plan (the 30-Day Hold Agreement and the Special Order Layaway) holds one piece per agreement; the Gift Registry Layaway holds the most, at 6.
